channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about RJ Barrett | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about RJ Barrett from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Kawhi Leonard, RJ Barrett
item.description:
Bobby Webster on if Kawhi Leonard’s extension will have any impact on RJ Barrett’s extension:

“No, I think ownership has been incredibly supportive. So, any time, financially, we want to make a go for it, they’re very supportive.”

Bobby Webster on Kawhi Leonard, RJ Barrett, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on RJ Barrett
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Darko Rajakovic on Barrett:

“RJ is the type of player who’s going to score 20 points if I call 20 plays for him or if I call 0 plays for him.”

Darko Rajakovic on RJ Barrett, Dec 8, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on RJ Barrett
item.description:
Eric Koreen:Darko Rajakovic:

“RJ Barrett is a very dynamic player. He is a very good cutter, good driver, an improved spot-up shooter, as well. I'm really excited to see how he's going to jell with our team.”

Darko Rajakovic on RJ Barrett, Dec 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @ekoreen.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett
item.description:
Fred Katz:Tom Thibodeau:

“The thing about RJ Barrett is he's very steady. He doesn't get rattled.... We gotta get him into the open floor. If we do that, he's gonna make shots. He gets downhill, he's tough to guard.”

Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett, Apr 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett
item.description:
Asked about RJ Barrett playing two minutes in the second half, Tom Thibodeau said,

“We just got behind by so much that we were just looking for life. And that group that was in there (after Barrett subbed out) gave us a little bit of a spark. So that's what we went with.”

Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett, Nov 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Leon Rose on Charlie Ward, RJ Barrett
item.description:
“One of our main goals has been to create internal stability. Signed RJ Barrett. First extension of a player since Charlie Ward,”

Leon Rose on Charlie Ward, RJ Barrett, Sep 23, 2022. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Charlie Ward on RJ Barrett
item.description:
“I’m just happy that (Barrett’s) done well and they’ve given him an opportunity to be there a few more years,”

Charlie Ward on RJ Barrett, Aug 31, 2022. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Rick Pitino on RJ Barrett
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Rick Pitino:

“RJ Barrett in college couldn't really shoot a 12-foot shot and I absolutely love players that work at their game and get better... I'm obviously a big Knicks fan so I'm a big RJ fan, but the fact that he's improved so much is amazing to me”

Rick Pitino on RJ Barrett, Jun 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett
item.description:
Ian Begley:Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett:

“His work ethic is top of the line, his attitude and approach are top of the line. He's a team-first guy. He’s 20 years old and he's only going to get better.”

Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett, Apr 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Ian Begley:Tom Thibodeau was asked about NYK's young players:

“Based on film, I really think RJ (Barrett) has a very bright future as does Mitchell Robinson. Those are 2 who stand out. But we have a lot of young talent. I don’t like to make qualifications on people until I get around them.”

Tom Thibodeau on RJ Barrett, Mitchell Robinson, Jul 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Wayne Ellington on RJ Barrett
item.description:
“In New York, I saw a young core that has a lot of talent, obviously with the guys that were there last season and they drafted RJ [Barrett]. I found that situation to be pretty intriguing for me and then definitely of course there was a need for three-point shooting,”

Wayne Ellington on RJ Barrett, Aug 22, 2019. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Jud Buechler on RJ Barrett
item.description:
Knicks Summer League CoachJud Buechler on RJ Barrett:

“There were ups and downs in the game for him, which you expect out of a rookie. We saw a lot of things we liked. We will continue to encourage him to keep shooting and aren’t worried about his shot not falling tonight.”

Jud Buechler on RJ Barrett, Jul 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Steve Mills on RJ Barrett, Ignas Brazdeikis
item.description:
“We were going to draft well and we were going to be diligent about how we build this team and not take any short cuts and not follow a path. We believe (Barrett and second-round pick Ignas Brazdeikis) are a part of that process, the young guys we added over the last two years and the draft picks we acquired.”

Steve Mills on RJ Barrett, Ignas Brazdeikis, Jun 21, 2019. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Jay Triano on RJ Barrett
item.description:
Triano remembered on Wednesday.

“We brought … (Bennett) in for the first time, and all the young players were in. And then (RJ Barrett) came in to work with Steve at the other end of the court. He and Steve were working together at the other end, and we were just like‘OK, he’s got a chance to be really good.’ And sure enough, he’s just kept getting better and better and better.”

Jay Triano on RJ Barrett, Jun 27, 2018. Source: The Athletic.
